KOSPI tumbles as Asian markets face fresh Iran shock and oil spike

Asian stocks fell on Thursday, reversing an early attempt at gains, as hotter US inflation data and a fresh escalation in the Iran conflict pushed investors back into defensive positions and drove oil prices higher. The mood across regional markets weakened after Wall Street suffered a sharp selloff
